parent_objective: audit capability-belief intervention results before any actor or recurrent fine-tune

public_gates: audit real-history capability movement versus observation-control movement
separate shuffled-history signal from matched-wrong and delayed-history signal
decide whether actor/fusion coupling design is admitted
keep PPO and checkpoint promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train in audit milestone
do not claim driver improvement from capability-belief movement
do not treat off-manifold random hidden sensitivity as self-ID proof
hypothesis: M601 provides enough belief-level real-history movement to justify a structured audit, but its mixed matched-wrong and delayed-history results must be interpreted before actor fine-tuning.
success_criteria: audit clearly states what M601 proves and does not prove
audit selects exactly one next branch or pre-registers a small branch comparison
audit keeps actor training blocked unless a guarded design is explicitly registered
failure_criteria: audit treats M601 as driver improvement
audit ignores zero-current dominance or delayed-history weakness

commands.name: audit
commands.command: Write M601 capability-belief intervention audit and choose next branch; no training.

decision_rule: M602 passes if it audits M601 without overclaiming and pre-registers the next no-oracle branch before actor updates.
